title: Saturn Would Float in Water

scenes.text: Saturn is huge, more than nine times wider than Earth.
But it's made mostly of hydrogen and helium, the lightest gases there are.
Its average density is about 0.7 grams per cubic centimetre. Water is 1.0.
So if you could find an ocean big enough, Saturn would bob on the surface like a giant beach ball.
Every other planet in the solar system would sink straight to the bottom.

description:
Saturn's average density is about 0.69 grams per cubic centimetre, lower than water, so in a big enough ocean it would float.
It's the only planet in the solar system that would.
Which planet should we cover next?
